clauses.clause: Riot infected: frontal MG hits visibly chip HP + recoil at every range incl. point blank; frontal MG kill ≤ 6 s (measured 3.7 s), flank ≤ 2 s; health bar always shown; one riot cop alone does not down a full-HP player that keeps firing (tune). PO: "I feel I have zero effect when I shoot them."
clauses.note: FAIL health-bar-always clause at both tiers in the normal follow camera, zoom1.5: unobscured healthy riot225HP at16.000m has no bar; healthy14.000m positive control has a full bar. After one actual frontal MG hit, HP222.48 and distance16.071892m, the bar appears. All6 full-resolution control frames personally inspected. Frozen HealthBars.barEligible excludes every healthy infected beyond15m before the mandatory-riot cap exception is applied. Separate verified physical MG assays at actual.9/1.6/3/6/20/26m, both tiers, record only weapon.army-mg attacks, kill in1.8–3.8s, and courier survives with78–100HP; isolated native flank1.7833s passes≤2. These numeric successes do not waive the visible missing bar. Earlier selection/occlusion setups are explicitly rejected, not game failures. Repro: full-health riot16m away in the normal wide camera; compare before and after2.52HP chip. PO subjective effect feedback is not promoted PASS.
